---
title: "FAQs"
---

**Is the training conducted online?**

No, this is an in-person training.

**Is there a cost to attend?**

No, the training is completely free. Food and drinks are provided;
participants are responsible for their own travel and accommodation.

**What level of R knowledge is required?**

Basic experience with R is required — this is not a beginner
programming course. Applicants should also have an understanding of
statistical inference and introductory knowledge of Bayesian
statistical methods.

**Is a certificate provided?**

Yes, a certificate of completion is awarded to all participants.

**What software will I need?**

R, version 4.0 or above.

**How competitive is selection?**

Highly competitive — around 30 participants are selected per cohort
from 400+ applicants.

**Where is the training held?**

Location varies by year — see the current year's Edition page for
exact venue and dates.

**Can I apply again if I wasn't selected?**

Yes — if you're not selected in one cycle, you're welcome to apply
again in a future cycle.
